Aliases: CVE-2026-23734

The fix for CVE-2025-27636 added setLowerCase(true) to HttpHeaderFilterStrategy so that case-variant header names such as 'CAmelExecCommandExecutable' are filtered out alongside 'CamelExecCommandExecutable'. The same setLowerCase(true) call was not applied to five non-HTTP HeaderFilterStrategy implementations: JmsHeaderFilterStrategy and ClassicJmsHeaderFilterStrategy in camel-jms, SjmsHeaderFilterStrategy in camel-sjms, CoAPHeaderFilterStrategy in camel-coap, and GooglePubsubHeaderFilterStrategy in camel-google-pubsub. entry.content:
Beetl's SpELFunction extension function has an expression injection risk

Aliases: CVE-2026-8759

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P

Affected:

  • com.ibeetl:beetl-spring-classic

A vulnerability was identified in xiandafu beetl up to 3.20.2. Affected is an unknown function of the file beetl-classic-integration/beetl-spring-classic/src/main/java/org/beetl/ext/spring/SpELFunction.java of the component SpELFunction. The manipulation leads to improper neutralization of special elements used in an expression language statement. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-2f54-v4hm-fx73: Apache Flink: Remote code execution via SQL injection in code generation
entry.content:
Apache Flink: Remote code execution via SQL injection in code generation

Aliases: BIT-flink-2026-35194, CVE-2026-35194

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N

Affected:

  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-planner_2.12 — fixed in 1.20.4
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-planner_2.12 — fixed in 2.0.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-planner_2.12 — fixed in 2.1.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-planner_2.12 — fixed in 2.2.1
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-api-java — fixed in 1.20.4
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-api-java — fixed in 2.0.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-api-java — fixed in 2.1.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-api-java — fixed in 2.2.1
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-runtime — fixed in 1.20.4
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-runtime — fixed in 2.0.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-runtime — fixed in 2.1.2
  • org.apache.flink:flink-table-runtime — fixed in 2.2.1

Code injection in SQL code generation in Apache Flink 1.15.0 through 1.20.x and 2.0.0 through 2.x allows authenticated users with query submission privileges to execute arbitrary code on TaskManagers via maliciously crafted SQL queries. The vulnerability affects JSON functions (1.15.0+) and LIKE expressions with ESCAPE clauses (1.17.0+). User-controlled strings are interpolated into generated Java code without proper escaping, allowing attackers to break out of string literals and inject arbitrary expressions. Users are recommended to upgrade to either version 1.20.4, 2.0.2, 2.1.2 or 2.2.1, which fixes this issue.

entry.content:
Undertow: Denial of Service via Multipart/Form-Data Parsing on HTTP GET Requests

Aliases: CVE-2026-3260

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • io.undertow:undertow-core — fixed in 2.4.0.Beta1

A flaw was found in Undertow. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending an HTTP GET request containing multipart/form-data content. If the underlying application processes parameters using methods like `getParameterMap()`, the server prematurely parses and stores this content to disk. This could lead to resource exhaustion, potentially resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-27vm-5vpj-rp5g: Apache Camel Vulnerable to Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
entry.content:
Apache Camel Vulnerable to Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel

Aliases: CVE-2026-40022

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N

Affected:

  • org.apache.camel:camel-platform-http-main — fixed in 4.14.6
  • org.apache.camel:camel-platform-http-main — fixed in 4.18.2
  • org.apache.camel:camel-platform-http-main — fixed in 4.20.0

When authentication is enabled on the Apache Camel embedded HTTP server or embedded management server (camel-platform-http-main) and a non-root context path such as /api or /admin is configured via camel.server.path or camel.management.path, the BasicAuthenticationConfigurer and JWTAuthenticationConfigurer classes derive the authentication path from properties.getPath() when camel.server.authenticationPath / camel.management.authenticationPath is not explicitly set. Combined with the Vert.x sub-router mounting model - the sub-router is mounted at _path_* and the authentication handler is registered inside the sub-router at the resolved path - this causes the authentication handler to match only the exact configured context path, not its subpaths. Unauthenticated requests to subpaths such a…

References:

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40022

fabric-sdk-java has ObjectInputStream.readObject() without ObjectInputFilter, which allows Java deserialization RCE

Aliases: BIT-hyperledger-fabric-orderer-2026-41586, BIT-hyperledger-fabric-peer-2026-41586, BIT-hyperledger-fabric-tools-2026-41586, CVE-2026-41586

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • org.hyperledger.fabric-sdk-java:fabric-sdk-java

## Summary This advisory covers the deprecated `fabric-sdk-java` client SDK. `Channel.java` implements `readObject()` and exposes `deSerializeChannel()` which call `ObjectInputStream.readObject()` on untrusted byte arrays without configuring an `ObjectInputFilter`. This is the classic Java deserialization RCE pattern. **Note:** `fabric-sdk-java` is deprecated and maintained in https://github.com/hyperledger/fabric-sdk-java. Filing here as that repo does not have private vulnerability reporting enabled. ## Affected Code ```java // src/main/java/org/hyperledger/fabric/sdk/Channel.java private void readObject(ObjectInputStream in) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException { in.defaultReadObject(); // No ObjectInputFilter configured } public Channel deSerializeChannel(byte[] channel…
